# Create browser handoff (`create_browser_handoff`)

MCP tool `create_browser_handoff` · scope `access_browser_login_handoff` · write

Creates a short-lived, one-time browser handoff URL for the Samebase account behind the current MCP
grant. The URL logs a browser into Samebase through Convex Auth after the user or agent opens it, so
the tool requires explicit `access_browser_login_handoff` consent.

Preconditions: the MCP grant must include `access_browser_login_handoff`, the client and grant must
still be active, and the user must still have current access to browser handoff. The tool never
returns MCP access tokens, MCP refresh tokens, Convex Auth JWTs, or Convex Auth refresh tokens.

The returned URL carries only a one-time bearer fragment and an optional Samebase-relative return
path. Show the returned URL to the user as a clickable link. It expires after 5 minutes. Keep the
link private and open it promptly. Only claim that the dashboard opened when a browser action
confirms it. The backend stores only a token hash and consumes the handoff on successful redemption
or account mismatch.

## Arguments

- `returnToPath` (string, optional): Optional Samebase-relative path to open after the browser
  session is created. Defaults to the dashboard.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expiresAt": {
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": ["url", "expiresAt"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
